Step 3. Consider the orthogonal operator \(A_{01320013}\) acting on the Riemann surface. By the orthogonal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{01320013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01320013\).

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via algebraic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
